    • add3DPanel0Drawers

      private void add3DPanel0Drawers(ArrayList<Drawer> drawers, int hh, int vv, int hx, int vx)
      Creates drawers for panel 0

      These drawers display cytoplasm and nucleus components for each of the three main projection planes (X, Y, and Z).

      Parameters:
      drawers - the list to which drawers are added
      hh - horizontal subdivision factor for the Z projection
      vv - vertical subdivision factor for the Z projection
      hx - horizontal subdivision factor for the X projection
      vx - vertical subdivision factor for the Y projection

    • add3DZDrawers

      private void add3DZDrawers(ArrayList<Drawer> drawers, int h, int v, int hh, int vv)
      Adds drawers for the Z-axis projections on panel 1.

      These drawers render STATE, POPULATION, VOLUME, HEIGHT, and OVERLAY views along the Z axis, plus grid overlays for each region.

      Parameters:
      drawers - the list to which drawers are added
      h - half the total horizontal panel width
      v - half the total vertical panel height
      hh - scaled horizontal subdivision for Z projections
      vv - scaled vertical subdivision for Z projections
